notes: Dynamax Desktop v3.1.48 safely retries concurrent CBT uploads against current online records, preserving earlier scores and original answers. Reports separate accepted, already recorded, unresolved and queued results; green requires verified online marks. Stop safely retains completed uploads. The deployed backend also restores complete loading of large scorebooks without re-pushing saved marks. Back up and close Dynamax before updating both CBT servers between examinations. No test recreation, re-pull or new tablet APK is required.
